meta.round_map: E(rho) = sum_s R_s P_s N(rho) P_s R_s^dagger, iterated as a 4x4 superoperator on the 2x2 logical space, so R rounds costs one eigendecomposition
meta.estimator: exact 3x7 Haar quadrature, exact for every R because the round map is linear in |psi><psi| -- there is no Monte-Carlo error in any curve here
meta.device_policy: cpu at n=5 (launch-bound), cuda at n>=7 (measured 3.6x and 8.3x faster); see device_benchmark
